advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Make the new test skip any URI-scheme link (reuse check_docs_index's `_SCHEME_RE`/`_link_targets`) instead of a hardcoded http/mailto prefix list.
evidence: check_docs_index.py already handles this generally: scripts/check_docs_index.py:28 `_SCHEME_RE = re.compile(r"^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9+.-]*:")`
ABSENCE: no non-http/mailto scheme links currently exist in docs/ (searched `](ftp`, `](tel:`), so this is latent, not an immediate failure.
advisory.finding: The new regression test hardcodes an external-scheme skip list (`"#", "http://", "https://", "mailto:"`) instead of matching any URI scheme; a future doc link using another scheme (e.g. `ftp://`, `file:`, `tel:`, or uppercase `HTTP://`) would be misclassified as a relative path and produce a spurious dead-link failure.
advisory.suggested_fix: Import and reuse `chk._link_targets` and `chk._SCHEME_RE` from the already-loaded module, applying the same scheme check the CI checker uses, so the test cannot drift from the checker.

coaching.coaching: Extract the duplicated logic in the external-scheme skip list in the link resolver into a shared helper.
coaching.subject: the external-scheme skip list in the link resolver
